title: Road Hazard Protection Schedule — Northgate Tire Center Packages
content:
# Northgate Tire Center — Road Hazard Coverage Schedule

Road hazard protection is part of three Northgate Tire Center packages: the Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard, Northgate Premium Tire Care and the Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard. Northgate Tire Mount & Balance, the Northgate Tire Installation Package and the Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package carry no road hazard protection, and every road hazard figure on those three packages is zero or none.

## Coverage terms

| Package | Road hazard included | Term from installation (calendar months) | Damage causes covered | Full-credit wear limit (percent of usable tread) | Replacements allowed across the package |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | no | 0 | none | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package | no | 0 | none | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | no | 0 | none | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | 36 | non-repairable puncture; sidewall impact | 25 | 2 |
| Northgate Premium Tire Care | yes | 60 | non-repairable puncture; sidewall impact; bead damage | 50 | 4 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | 36 | non-repairable puncture; sidewall impact | 25 | 2 |

## Replacement terms

| Package | Proration beyond full-credit wear | Mounting, balancing and valve stem free on a replacement | Credit payable in cash | Matching full-size spare covered | Replacement keeps the remaining term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | by remaining usable tread | no | no | no | yes |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package | by remaining usable tread | no | no | no | yes |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | by remaining usable tread | no | no | no | yes |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | by remaining usable tread | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Northgate Premium Tire Care | by remaining usable tread | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | by remaining usable tread | yes | no | yes | yes |

## Reading the schedule

- The term is counted in calendar months from the package's installation date: 36 months on the two "with Road Hazard" packages, 60 months on Northgate Premium Tire Care.
- Bead damage is a covered cause on Northgate Premium Tire Care only.
- The replacement count is a total for the whole package, not per tire: 2 on the two "with Road Hazard" packages, 4 on Northgate Premium Tire Care.
- The full-credit wear limit is the tread wear, as a percentage of usable tread, up to which a road hazard replacement is credited at the full price: 25 percent on the two "with Road Hazard" packages and 50 percent on Northgate Premium Tire Care.
- On no package can a road hazard or treadwear credit be paid out in cash instead of being applied to a replacement.
